purpose: Static-CAD full-course integration test; VIO pose, immutable geofence, no sensor map updates; not live-mapping qualification

launch_clearance.reference: Nominal supplied-course training fixture: 0.52 m clear radius, 0.1–1.5 m above initial body origin. CAD side clearance is 0.5334 m; the shifted training start has 0.6064 m rear clearance. Must be checked at each physical setup. Outside this fixture, the declared CAD prior seeds the obstacle map and sensor observations revise it.

flight_envelope.reference: Measured-centre containment: surveyed XY boundary inset by 0.35 m (0.279686 m swept airframe plus 0.070314 m provisional localization allowance). Tracking is checked on the measured position, not double-counted as another arbitrary envelope inset. Trajectory collision radius and ROG inflation remain unchanged; altitude retains the course operating constraint.

hard_boundary.reference: Nominal 6.096 m square enclosure, training launch ENU (-2.5146,1.1144), yaw +90 deg; map x=north,y=west. Floor conservatively at initial body z=0; ceiling 2.95 m above body, below nominal 3.048 m roof. Hardware requires surveyed alignment.

takeoff_horizontal_envelope.reference: CAD training launch corridor: rear wall 0.6064 m behind body, side walls 0.5334 m each side. Centre limits reserve 0.4 m to CAD walls; forward bound conservatively mirrored. Requires verified initial placement and clear takeoff volume; no sensor-derived free-space claim. Bounds rounded inward to the 5 cm map lattice.
